mapper.select: SELECT o.ORDER_ID FROM ORDERS o JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN ORDER_ITEMS i ON i.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDER_ARCHIVE (ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID) SELECT o.ORDER_ID, o.CUSTOMER_ID FROM ORDERS o JOIN CUSTOMERS c ON c.CUSTOMER_ID = o.CUSTOMER_ID WHERE o.PROCESSED = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ORDER_ITEMS WHERE ORDER_ID IN (SELECT ORDER_ID FROM ORDER_ARCHIVE)
